title: Finite covers kill classes with constant coefficients (Stacks 09ZD (2))
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], $Z\subseteq X$ a closed subscheme (a closed immersion $Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]), $M$ a finite abelian group with constant sheaf $\underline M$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale sites, $q\ge1$ an integer and $\xi\in H^q(Z_{\Et},\underline M)$ a class of etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then there exists a morphism $X'\to X$ which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] such that the pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] of $\xi$ along the projection $X'\times_XZ\to Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is zero in $H^q((X'\times_XZ)_{\Et},\underline M)$ (the inverse image of the constant sheaf $\underline M$ on $Z$ being identified with the constant sheaf $\underline M$ on $X'\times_XZ$, [lemma-constructible-pullback-constant]).

source.place: Lemma 09ZD (label lemma-integral-cover-trivial-cohomology), part (2), etale-cohomology.tex line 14467; proof: part (1) (integral surjective X' -> X with H^q(Z', M) = 0 for all closed Z' of X', via Lemma 09ZC lemma-gabber-for-absolutely-algebraically-closed), then write X' as a limit of finite finitely presented X'_i (Limits, Lemma 09YZ, label lemma-integral-limit-finite-and-finite-presentation) and use Lemma 03Q6 (label lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology) to stop at a finite stage.
